- **G? [M] Hide a kind of place from its card, and clock towers apart from water towers** (2026-11-21) · Earn · aligned
  Area: explore, walk-screen, what-im-into. From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-21). Brief: docs/research/poi-hide-from-card.md.
  Calls: the card's own kind, and a subtype's card offers its whole parent kind too ("I should be able to distinctly hide clocks, but keep the rest of historical monuments"); kind only for now, no "Not this one" or "Show less"; a "?" card names the kind, never the place; clock towers and water towers split in this slice. Decision 0253.
  Touches: VISION.md Always, "Restraint in motion, colour and copy"; Never, "rankings of places", "Tallies such as '12 of 87'", "A capture behind a menu, a drawer or an extra tap"; decisions 0115, 0191 (amended), 0192 (amended), 0230.
  The slice: 1. An unfound place's card on the walk has More (…) at its top right, in ink, 44 pt, spoken "More"; the kind is a muted line under the name. 2. More opens the bottom-sheet menu (as a moment's): "Hide <kind>" with a quiet second line, "What I'm into", Cancel; words lowercase mid-sentence. 3. A place of a subtype offers "Hide <subtype>" (its parent stays) and "Hide all <parent kind>". 4. Hide turns off the same switch What I'm into shows (`withKind`, `saveSettings`), closes the card and the menu, and every unfound place of that kind leaves the walk's map at once. 5. A slab in the place offer's look says "<Kind> hidden from the map." with Undo and Close, announced politely, until used or dismissed; Undo turns the switch back on. 6. A "?" card's menu names its kind, never the place. 7. A found place's card has no Hide. 8. "What I'm into" from the menu opens the page from the walk (Back reads "Walk") at that kind's row. 9. No count, number or accent colour in the menu, the slab or the card; the capture row unchanged and first. 10. "Water and clock towers" becomes "Clock towers" and "Water towers", each a switch, both on by default; a reader with the shared switch off keeps both off.
  Precedent: Google Discover's card More ("Not interested in [Topic]", "Don't show content from [Source]") and YouTube's More ("Not interested", "Don't recommend channel"), both verified Nov 21; OsmAnd chooses POI categories in Configure map (unverified). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Hide a kind of thing from one item".
  Payoff: a kind the walker never stops for leaves the map in two taps, from the place that prompted it, on every walk with Places on. Cost: M; about nine source files (`app/walk.tsx`, a new `components/walk/PlaceMenu.tsx`, `explore/placeCard.ts`, `explore/explore.ts`, `discovery/subtypes.ts`, `discovery/types.ts`, `presence/presence.ts` with a `PRESENCE_CODE` bump, `intoNav.ts`, `IntoPage.tsx`); no native module; the sheet over the walk map never run on a phone. Reopens: explore, walk-screen, what-im-into. After it: "Not this one" for a single place, if hiding a kind is not enough.
  Instead: criteria 1, 2, 4, 5 and 9 alone (the card's own kind, no parent, no split).
  Mock-up: https://claude.ai/artifact/B2rLDb6EvciUx6LaUFJVHC (docs/mockups/poi-hide-from-card/), not yet approved: the owner chose "Redraw" (2026-11-21).
  Open: the look: the owner asked for a redraw of the mock-up (Nov 21) without yet saying what to change; the build waits for the approved drawing (decision 0252).
  Open: whether a found place's card keeps More with only "What I'm into" (drawn with the redraw).
  Done when: on the walk at 390 x 844 with Places on, a plaque's card hides plaques in two taps and the war memorial beside them stays; Undo brings them back; a clock tower's card hides clock towers and leaves the water tower's pin.
